item.title: Beyond All Reason (Free Total Annihilation Inspired RTS)
item.description:
📝 The shape of every battlefield in-game imposes which strategies work and which units are effective. Utilize over 10 different unit classes, including all-terrain Experimental units, to work your way to victory. Your power lies in the careful balance of exponentially growing your resource income and the production of devastating war machines.
🔗 Read more: https://www.beyondallreason.info

item.title: The case against geometric algebra (2024)
item.description:
📝 They act like this is clearly the way that geometry should be done and everyone else can’t just see it yet, and they have this weird religious zeal about it that is problematic and offputting. They’re very fixable, but first you have to notice that something is wrong. So I would like to see that change, and to do that we need to establish what’s wrong with it now.
🔗 Read more: https://alexkritchevsky.com/2024/02/28/geometric-algebra.html

item.title: David Ahl's Basic Computer Games Ported to C
item.description:
📝 David Ahl's BASIC Computer Games These haven't been tested, validated, debugged, or verified. This repository contains a 'C' port of the classic GW-BASIC games from David Ahl's "BASIC Computer Games" and "More BASIC Computer Games" originally published by Creative Computing. Background & History BASIC Computer Games on Archive.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/proteanthread/bcg
